project_type: Standalone multi-surface AWS demo: AWS CDK v2 (TypeScript) infra+pipeline, AWS SAM (Python 3.12) serverless app, Docker/ECS container path, bash deploy scripts, markdown docs. Greenfield (target folder was empty).
build_system: CDK app lives in <ROOT>/infra with its own package.json (npm). SAM app in <ROOT>/app. No monorepo tooling, no root package.json. Each surface builds independently.
build_command: cd <ROOT>/infra && npm install && npx cdk synth > /dev/null
test_command: cd <ROOT>/app && python3 -m pip install -r dev-requirements.txt && python3 -m pytest -q
verification_instructions: LOCAL ONLY, never deploy. (1) cd <ROOT>/infra && npm install && npx cdk synth >/dev/null  (export CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=111111111111 if synth needs an account; region is pinned to ap-southeast-1 in bin). (2) cd <ROOT>/app && python3 -m pytest -q passes. (3) bash -n <ROOT>/deploy.sh && bash -n <ROOT>/destroy.sh. (4) python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("<ROOT>/.kiro/hooks/generate-tests-on-save.kiro.hook"))' parses and matches v1 hook schema. (5) sam validate --lint in <ROOT>/app IF sam CLI present, else confirm template.yaml parses as YAML (permissive loader for SAM ! intrinsic tags). (6) python3 -c json.load for events/*.json and reference/orders-queue.cfn.json. NEVER run cdk deploy / cdk bootstrap / docker push / aws commands that create resources.
snapshot_or_generated_files: cdk.out/ is produced by cdk synth and is gitignored (not committed). No other generated/checked-in artifacts.
environment_constraints: Local tools confirmed: node v25.x, npm 11.x, python3 3.13, aws-cli 2.34, docker present. SAM CLI is NOT installed locally, so sam validate is best-effort; YAML parse is the hard gate. Do NOT create real AWS resources. Region MUST be ap-southeast-1 in every file (CDK env, samconfig.toml, deploy.sh, destroy.sh, SNS, alarms, runbook).
contribution_requirements: No repo-level AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/steering files exist. Rules come from the task: everything self-contained under <ROOT>; do NOT read or import from /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/applications or /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/demo/session3; pinned/explicit dependency versions; aws-cdk-lib v2; scripts bash with set -euo pipefail and a confirmation prompt on destructive steps; keep costs minimal (public subnets, no NAT, 256/512 Fargate, desiredCount 1-2, ECR lifecycle keep-10).
key_patterns: CDK v2: single aws-cdk-lib import, constructs ^10. Pin aws-cdk-lib 2.160.0 / aws-cdk (toolkit) 2.160.0 / constructs ^10.3.0 / typescript ~5.5.4 / ts-node ^10.9.2 / @types/node ^20. Stacks split by layer: NetworkDataStack (VPC public-only no-NAT, DynamoDB, SQS, SSM param, Secrets Manager secret, AppConfig app/env/profile/deployment) and AppPipelineStack (ECR+lifecycle keep-10, ECS Fargate+ALB w/ circuit breaker min100/max200, CodePipeline S3-source->CodeBuild->deploy-test->manual-approval(SNS)->deploy-prod, SNS topic, CloudWatch alarms). CodePipeline SOURCE is S3 (versioned bucket + source.zip) — no GitHub/CodeCommit. Lambda canary via SAM DeploymentPreference CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent5Minutes with CloudWatch alarm rollback. Headless gate in buildspec is a documented no-op exit 0 placeholder modeled as `kiro --headless --prompt "review the deploy log"`. Kiro hook v1: when.type PostFileSave, matcher \.py$, then.type agent. API GW happy event body is a STRING (not object).
